subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as synonym for the underlined word.

Mohan is __deprived__ of the opportunity to start his business.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"deprived"** means** to deny the possession or use of something. **(वंचित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The children were **deprived of **basic necessities due to the economic crisis.
 
 
 
• **"Divested" **refers to **the action of depriving someone of power, rights, or possessions**. (विवश करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **divested** of his authority after the scandal.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **'deprived' **is **'divested'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Renewal **(नवीकरण): The action of extending the period of validity of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The renewal of the contract took place last week.
 
 
 
• **Reconstruct **(पुनर्निर्माण): To build or form something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
 
 
• **Example: **They had to reconstruct the house after the earthquake.
 
 
 
• **Restore** (पुनर्स्थापित करना): To bring back a previous right, practice, or situation.
 
 
• **Example:** Efforts are being made to restore peace in the region.
